```text
# PR #4934: Patch: Tnack Trav copying "Aura: Has N random combat keywords" draws its N keywords, where the copied Aura now gives it none

Closes #4839

## What changed

When S #20 Tnack Trav copies M #65 Keymaster Keenus or S #111 Shockwave447, it now draws its own keywords as the copied text lands. Before, it ended with the Aura and none of the keywords.

- **`crates/engine/src/effects/buff.rs`**: the top-up inside `follow_combat_keywords` is moved into a new `pub(crate) fn top_up_to_number`. `follow_combat_keywords` still runs it only on a card that already holds a list, so the Buff, set-number and Make Radiant paths behave as before.
- **`crates/engine/src/effects/copy_text.rs`**: `copy_unit_text` calls `top_up_to_number` on the copier right after writing the `__unitText` record and before the `transformed` event.
  - `param` already reads the copied face's number from that record.
  - The draw comes from the seeded rng at that one fixed point.
  - A copied text whose Aura follows no number draws nothing, so every other copy plays as before.
- **Spec**:
  - new ruling `spec/rulings/R4839000.md`;
  - its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4839.md`;
  - one sentence each in §6.3's "Copy a Unit's text" row and §8.10's row 20.
- **Tnack Trav**: one header-comment line in `c020_tnack_trav.rs`. The script's code is unchanged.

## Tests

Engine, a new module `r4839000_…` in `crates/engine/tests/rules/unit_text.rs`. It uses a fixture Legendary with the Aura (3 keywords on the base face, 6 on the Radiant one) and has 7 tests:
- the copy draws 3 different keywords from the pool, all active, and leaves the target's list empty;
- the `radiant` option draws 6;
- the same seed gives the same draw;
- copying a text without the Aura shows none of the list and keeps it whole, and copying the Aura back draws nothing (rng cursor unchanged);
- a later Radiant copy tops 3 up to 6 and keeps the first 3 in order;
- a copier made Radiant keeps the copied number and draws nothing;
- an Immutable copier draws nothing.

Cards, in `c020_tnack_trav.rs`, 3 tests:
- copying Keenus gives 5 keywords plus Equip;
- a Radiant Tnack copying Keenus gives 10;
- copying an enemy Shockwave447 gives 3, still there and active a full round later.

All of these fail on `main` except the Immutable test, which only guards that nothing is drawn.

Commands run and what they printed:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' -- r3778000 r1850000 r4839000`: 11 and 12 passed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards -- c065_keymaster_keenus c111_shockwave447 c020_tnack_trav`: 31 passed.
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: exit 0, 23,971 passed, 0 failed, 52 ignored; no diff under `apps/web/src/wire`.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check` and `spec check`: all ok.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` (CI's gate): green.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/aura-keywords-real.test.tsx`: 2 passed.

### Patch fragment: none
`classify --base origin/main --parent-bin <main's build> --claims --json` printed `{"kind":"internal","cards":[],"stage2":"ran","problems":[]}`.
- Stage 2 only runs when the checkout's HEAD is the head commit, so I put this diff on a throwaway commit in a separate worktree, built it, and classified from there. That worktree and branch are removed.
- No card was named, so I wrote no fragment: a `--plays` claim that the games don't show fails `rust (classify)` (R1370000).

## Decisions the issue left open
- **The list stays when a text without the Aura is copied.** It is not cleared, because R3778000 keeps one list per stay; clearing it would re-roll on every copy back.
- **The target's list is not copied.** Each card holds its own draw.
- **Replays are not kept on the old behaviour.** A game played after v0.6.0c, before this change, in which Tnack copied such an Aura is now refused by its final hash (the #4410 precedent). The alternative, a new argument to the verb plus a kept Tnack script, is a lot of code for a few replays. Through v0.6.0c the kept scripts follow no number, so those replays are unchanged.

## Where I departed from the plan
- **One claim dropped from the ruling.** The plan's ruling said "a Buff, a set number or a Radiant face then draws the rest". A test showed that is false for a copier:
  - Number changes (Buff, set number) reach only numbers the copier's own card declares, and Tnack declares none.
  - A copier made Radiant keeps the face it copied (R1850000).

  So the ruling states this as how things stand, says it leaves it alone, and the set-number test is gone. Whether a Number change should reach a copied number is a separate question.
- **Tests changed.** I added a test for the Radiant-flip case and one for a later Radiant copy topping up.

## Worth a second look
- **A failure that was already on `main`.** I also ran a fuzz wave with Tnack, Keenus and Shockwave447 forced into every deck (`fuzz --seeds 200 --cards stinkyscape-020,meditative-065,stinkyscape-111`). CI does not run this wave. 199 of 200 seeds pass; seed 100 fails I21: Core #88 Twisting Nether destroys a Core #30 Archivist that is Immune to Spells, after p1 sets a card face-down cloaked on turn 30.
  - I rebuilt with the new call commented out, which is `main`'s behaviour, and seed 100 failed identically. So my change did not cause it.
  - I didn't fix it; it probably deserves its own issue. Reproduce with `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 100 --seeds 1 --cards stinkyscape-020,meditative-065,stinkyscape-111`.
- **Ordering.** The draw happens before `transformed` and emits no event of its own.
```

**Issue #4839 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4839: Patch: Tnack Trav copying "Aura: Has N random combat keywords" draws its N keywords, where the copied Aura now gives it none
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

S #20 Tnack Trav ("Cry: Copy the text of a Legendary or Mythic Unit on the field") copies M #65 Keymaster Keenus (Legendary, "Aura: Has 5 random combat keywords") or S #111 Shockwave447 (Mythic, "Aura: Has 3 random combat keywords") and ends with the Aura and **none of the keywords**.

- The keywords of such an Aura are drawn only on the card's own `summoned` event, or by a Fuse. Tnack's own `summoned` has passed by the time its Cry copies, and the copy draws nothing: `copy_unit_text` (`crates/engine/src/effects/copy_text.rs:31-70`) writes only the `__unitText` record.
- It cannot recover later: a Buff of the number, or being made Radiant, also draws nothing, because `follow_combat_keywords` (`crates/engine/src/effects/buff.rs:469-474`) returns early for a card that holds no keyword list yet ("a card holding no list yet has its arrival draw (or its fusion's) still to come").

Tnack shows `[Equip]` after copying Keenus and `[]` after copying Shockwave447, still empty a full round later.

### What should happen

- R1850000: the copy "gives the running card the text the target Unit runs now: its printed keywords, its aura, its triggers…".
- R3778000: "Its keywords now always match the number its text shows", and "A Fuse that keeps another card (an Equip among them) has the kept card draw only what its number asks beyond any list it holds".

So the copier should draw its own N as the text lands, as a Fuse's kept card does.

### How to reproduce

Two tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7), in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_stinky.rs` at ca59d7a](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/ca59d7a/crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_stinky.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`; the file sits in the AI crate's tests only because that target links the testkit and every card).

```rust
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const P1: PlayerId = PlayerId::P1;
const P2: PlayerId = PlayerId::P2;
const FILLER: &str = "core-005";
const TNACK: &str = "stinkyscape-020";
fn game(opts: serde_json::Value) -> Scenario {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    let mut s = scenario(opts);
    for player in [P1, P2] { s.state_mut().players[player].auto_end_turn = Some(false); }
    s
}
fn combat_keywords(s: &Scenario, card: &CardInstance) -> Vec<Keyword> {
    s.stats(card).keywords.into_iter().filter(|keyword| *keyword != Keyword::Equip).collect()
}

#[test]
fn tnack_trav_copying_keenus_has_the_auras_five_combat_keywords() {
    const KEENUS: &str = "meditative-065";
    let mut s = game(json!({
        "p1": { "hand": [KEENUS, TNACK, FILLER], "library": vec[FILLER; 6], "mana": 10 },
        "p2": { "hand": [FILLER, FILLER], "library": vec[FILLER; 6] },
    }));
    s.play(KEENUS, json!({ "zone": 1 }));
    let keenus = s.unit_at(P1, 1);
    assert_eq!(combat_keywords(&s, &keenus).len(), 5, "Keenus, played, drew its Aura's five");
    s.state_mut().players[P1].mana.current = 10;
    s.play(TNACK, json!({ "zone": 3, "targets": pick::instance(&keenus) }));
    let tnack = s.unit_at(P1, 3);
    assert_eq!(tnack.def_id, TNACK);
    assert_eq!(combat_keywords(&s, &tnack).len(), 5,
        "R1850000, R3778000: the copied Aura \"Has 5 random combat keywords\" gives Tnack Trav five; it has {:?}",
        s.stats(&tnack).keywords);
}
```

The second test copies an enemy `stinkyscape-111` and reads Tnack a full round later.

Output today: `…gives Tnack Trav five; it has [Equip]   left: 0   right: 5` and `…gives Tnack Trav three; it has []   left: 0   right: 3`.

### Where

The rules engine: `crates/engine/src/effects/copy_text.rs` (`copy_unit_text`), with `crates/engine/src/effects/buff.rs` (`follow_combat_keywords`).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- In `copy_unit_text`, after writing the record, run the arrival draw for the copied text when the copied script has `combat_keywords_follow`: the same top-up a Fuse runs on its kept card (draw what the number asks beyond any list the card holds). The draw comes from the game's seeded rng, in a fixed place in the effect's order.
- Check the reverse too: a copier that already holds a list from an earlier copy and then copies a text with no such Aura (does the old list stay? R3778000 says the keywords match the number the text shows).
- No test pairs the cards today: Tnack's tests never copy Keenus or Shockwave447, and neither card's tests name Tnack. Put the proving tests in `c020_tnack_trav.rs` (CLAUDE.md rule 6) and the engine's test beside `copy_text`'s.
- The Aura works on the original (Keenus played from hand shows 5 in the same test), and Anomaly Found! boards draw the drones' keywords correctly, so this is the copy path alone. R1850000 lists no exception for an Aura that keeps state.
- Not the Transform issue (#4816): `copy_unit_text` is a different verb.
- A neighbour seen by reading only, not part of this: copying a Legendary Weapon or Miner hands Tnack the printed Starship Piece keyword, so its death would fuse a Tnack Trav into the Dormant Starship. That follows from R1850000 with R1852000 and may be intended.
- A card change in play: it needs its pending patch fragment (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`).

Found by an audit of the Stinkyscape card scripts against their printed text; the reproductions were run and the code path read before filing.

## Steps

1. **`crates/engine/src/effects/buff.rs`, `follow_combat_keywords` (line ~469).** Replace the function body and add a helper right after it. The logic is unchanged and only moves. In the doc comment of `follow_combat_keywords`, change "(or its fusion's)" to "(or its fusion's, or its copy's, R4839000)".
   ```rust
   pub(crate) fn follow_combat_keywords(ctx: &mut EffectContext<'_>, card_id: &str) {
       if find_instance(ctx.sink.state, card_id)
           .is_some_and(|card| card.memory.contains_key(COMBAT_KEYWORDS_KEY))
       {
           top_up_to_number(ctx, card_id);
       }
   }

   /// R3778000, R4839000: tops the list of `card_id`, a card on the field, up to the number its text
   /// follows (`Script::combat_keywords_follow`), read as its Aura reads it (`top_up_onto`); a card off
   /// the field, or whose text follows no number, draws nothing. `follow_combat_keywords` runs it on a
   /// card holding a list; `copy_unit_text` on the copier as the copied text lands, as a Fuse's kept card
   /// draws its own.
   pub(crate) fn top_up_to_number(ctx: &mut EffectContext<'_>, card_id: &str) {
       let Some(card) = find_instance(ctx.sink.state, card_id).cloned() else {
           return;
       };
       if card.zone.z() != ZoneName::Field {
           return;
       }
       let Some(number) = crate::scripts::script_of(ctx.sink.state, &card).combat_keywords_follow else {
           return;
       };
       let count = param(
           &HookArgs { state: &*ctx.sink.state, self_: &card, radiant: card.radiant },
           number,
       );
       top_up_onto(ctx, &card, count, COMBAT_KEYWORDS_KEY);
   }
   ```
   `card` must be fetched after the copy record is written. `script_of` and `param` then read the copied text, and the copied face's number comes from the record (`params.rs:398`).

2. **`crates/engine/src/effects/copy_text.rs`, `copy_unit_text`.** Directly after the `if let Some(live) = find_instance_mut(...) { live.memory.insert(UNIT_TEXT_KEY…) }` block and before `ctx.events.push(GameEvent::Transformed {…})`, add:
   ```rust
   // R4839000: a copied Aura that draws its keywords draws the copier's own as the text lands.

## Risks

- **Determinism:** the draw comes only from `ctx.sink.rng`, at one point (after the record, before `transformed`). Copies of texts without the Aura draw nothing, so every existing seeded test and game is unchanged.
- **Replays:** this changes the verb for every catalog. Games after v0.6.0c in which Tnack copied Keenus or Shockwave447 are refused by their final hash, not shown wrong (the #4760 precedent, written in the ruling). Do not add `KEPT_SCRIPTS`.
- **Fuzz invariant (R636 Windfury, `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`):** a copier that draws Windfury is seen at its own play's end (`note_entry_windfury`) or at the next action's start (`note_windfury`). One gap exists: a copier that copies, attacks twice and dies within one autopilot action (copied printed Windfury has the same gap today). If a fuzz seed flags this, record it in `crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/` and fix the invariant there; never skip it.
- **Hidden information:** the drawn keywords sit on a field card, as Keenus's already do, so nothing new is shown.

## Open questions

Two decisions the issue left open, each made above:
- No kept script for old replays, rather than a new `CopyUnitTextArgs` flag plus a kept Tnack script.
- The list is kept, not cleared, when a text without the Aura is copied.

A person may overrule either; the plan does not depend on anyone first.
````
